# ballaCity

> Find and join pickup baseball, basketball, soccer, pickleball and more near you. Discover local games, teams, trainers and gyms, and grab your spot fast.

ballaCity is a pickup sports community app. Players discover nearby games on a map or list, request to join, and follow teams, trainers and gyms. Hosts create games under a team, trainer or gym profile and manage rosters, approvals and entry fees.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What ballaCity is, featured pickup games, and how to get started.
- [Teams, trainers & gyms](/orgs): Browse local organizations hosting games and training.
- [Pickup games](/pickup): How pickup games work on ballaCity.
- [Plans](/plans): Membership plans and pricing.
- [Shop](/shop): ballaCity gear and merchandise.
- [Reviews](/reviews): Reviews of gyms, trainers and hosts.
- [Safety](/safety): Safety practices, reporting, and youth protections.
- [Community guidelines](/community-guidelines): Expected conduct for players and hosts.
- [Trust center](/trust-center): Privacy, security and compliance overview.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the ballaCity team.

## Optional
